messages.subject: Failed to install On Ubuntu
parts:
ggvis seems great to me, but I failed on trying to install it. 
Please help to have a look, thanks.

install_github(c("assertthat", "testthat"))  <-- ok
install_github("ggvis", "rstudio")  <-- failed

I would like to know how to try these demos ?
